# AffiLayer — full reference

> AffiLayer is a new global CPA affiliate network, operated by MarketSync
> Global LLC, a registered company in New Mexico, USA. It opened on
> 7 November 2026. The network is deliberately small at launch: a focused
> offer catalogue, a tracking engine the team can explain, and applications
> and conversions reviewed by hand. Contact: support@affilayer.com.

## What AffiLayer is

AffiLayer connects advertisers who need customers with affiliates who can
reach them. Advertisers publish offers with a stated payout model (CPA, CPL,
CPS or CPC), allowed countries, devices and traffic sources, and daily and
total caps. Affiliates browse the marketplace, apply where approval is
required, and generate tracking links with up to five sub-parameters.

SmartLink is one tracking link for all of an affiliate's traffic. Each visitor
is routed to an eligible offer based on their country and device, using clear
deterministic rules. It does not use AI optimisation and it does not guarantee
earnings. It pays exactly like the offer the visitor was routed to.

## Tracking and money

- Every click gets a unique click ID with country, device, referrer and
  sub-parameters, and stays linked to its conversion.
- Conversions are signed, deduplicated by idempotency key, and recorded as
  pending until reviewed.
- Commissions move through pending, approved, rejected or reversed states,
  with a record of each change, in an append-only commission ledger.
- Payouts are manual and admin-approved. The default schedule is Net30:
  approved commissions become payable 30 days after the end of the month in
  which they were approved.
- Payout methods and minimum thresholds are shown in the account dashboard;
  no fixed list is published because methods depend on country and setup.
- The network does not run traffic itself, does not buy traffic on behalf of
  either side, and does not promise results. Performance depends on the offer,
  the audience and the traffic.

## Rules

- Fraudulent traffic of any kind is prohibited: bots, misleading creatives,
  forced clicks, and incentivised traffic that misrepresents the offer.
- Chat traffic and incentivised traffic are not accepted.
- Advertisers can restrict traffic sources, GEOs and devices per offer.
- No bonus or referral program at launch.

## Status (honest)

- Live: direct CPA offers, SmartLink, full-funnel tracking, commission ledger,
  manual admin-approved payouts, application review.
- In progress: the Supabase backend that turns demo-mode writes into stored
  records is still being connected; the offer catalogue is small while
  advertisers are onboarded offer by offer.
- The web app currently runs in demo mode (sample data shown where Supabase
  is not configured).

## Languages and countries

The public site is available in English, Spanish and Portuguese. English
lives at the root URLs (affilayer.com, affilayer.com/affiliates, …); Spanish
under /es/ and Portuguese under /pt/ (for example /es/geo/us and
/pt/affiliates). The dashboards are in English for now.

Country pages live under /geo/: United States (/geo/us), United Kingdom
(/geo/uk), Canada (/geo/ca), Australia (/geo/au), Germany (/geo/de), France
(/geo/fr), Brazil (/geo/br) and India (/geo/in). Each page describes the same
global product — tracking, ledger, manual Net30 payouts — with no local
offices, staff or country-specific offer counts claimed. AffiLayer is open
worldwide; there is no restricted country list.

## FAQ (short answers)

- What is AffiLayer? A CPA affiliate network: advertisers publish offers,
  affiliates promote them and earn commission on attributed conversions.
- Which verticals? Dating, Finance, Gaming, Sweepstakes, Nutra, iGaming.
- How long does approval take? Typically within 2 business days.
- How and when do I get paid? Manual, admin-approved payouts; Net30 default.
- What traffic is not allowed? Bots, misleading creatives, forced clicks,
  incentivised traffic, chat traffic, and any source an offer restricts.
- Is there a minimum payout? Thresholds are set in account settings and shown
  on the payouts page.
